NIFTY Opening-Range Reversal — risk:reward sweep · v3 · v2 · RSI≤40 · z≥1 · consec≥1

v3 (v2 rule). Opening range = first 5-min candle (09:15–09:20). 2A — every candle 09:20→t stayed below OR high + down-trend → BUY ATM CE. 2B — every candle stayed above OR low + up-trend → BUY ATM PE. Where NIFTY sits at t does not matter. Confirmations: RSI(14) ≤ 40 (CE) / ≥ 60 (PE); stretched ≥ 1σ from the 09:20–t mean; ≥ 1 consecutive candle(s) still running with the move. Trend mode: moderate; nearest expiry; stop 0.1% of spot.
Stop-loss fixed at 0.1% of NIFTY spot; target = stop × R. Squared off at 15:00 if still open. Stop is assumed hit first when one candle spans both levels. Option prices are 1-minute closes; PnL is in option points and in ₹ for 1 lot (65).
Range 2026-03-12 → 2026-09-11 · 124 trading days.
